claims.claim: Wooden pallets are the backbone of supply chain logistics, manufacturing, and warehousing, while...
claims.evidence: Seller text is generic and does not describe the specific pallet condition, size, quantity, or grade.

risks.risk: Wrong pallet size/standard (e.g., not the size you need for your racks/containers). Photos don’t show a readable size stamp or full dimensions.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo with a measuring tape across the pallet (length and width) and a clear shot of any stamp/mark on the wood.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic wooden pallet with unknown dimensions (worst-case fit risk).

risks.risk: Condition issues (cracks, broken boards, loose nails, insect damage) that affect load capacity and usability.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of all corners and underside stringers, plus one photo showing any broken/slightly lifted boards.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed for heavy-duty use (worst-case: usable but with possible wear).

risks.risk: Treatment/infestation status (heat-treated vs chemically treated) which matters for food/export compliance.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the pallet stamp (e.g., IPPC mark) on the deck/stringer.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as untreated/unknown compliance (worst-case: only for non-sensitive internal use).

risks.risk: Quantity uncertainty (photos show at least one pallet and stacked pallets, but the exact number you’ll receive is unclear).
risks.proof: Ask for the exact count available per pickup and a photo showing the stack height/count.
risks.if_unproven: Priced per pallet as shown, with no bulk discount assumed until quantity is confirmed.

proof_requests: Provide exact pallet dimensions (length x width) with a measuring tape in-frame.
Provide a clear close-up of the pallet stamp/mark (IPPC/heat-treated mark if present).
Provide close-up photos of all 4 corners and the underside stringers (showing any cracks/loose boards).
Confirm the exact quantity available for this pickup (how many pallets per bundle/stack).
response.reason: The photos confirm it’s a wooden pallet, but key pricing drivers for second-hand pallets in Rivers (size/standard, condition/load-worthiness, and treatment stamp) are not verifiable from the images provided. Without those, a safe worst-case price can’t be confidently set.
